name: M.E.G. (Major Explorer Group)
description: The largest and most organized group in the Backrooms. They document levels, entities, and objects. They have bases on many levels and provide resources to wanderers.

name: The Bacteria
description: A mysterious and hostile entity that hunts wanderers. It is attracted to sound and movement.

name: The Mapping Community
description: A group of wanderers who create maps of the Backrooms. Their maps are often inaccurate due to the shifting nature of the levels.

name: The Survivors
description: A loose coalition of wanderers who band together for survival. They share resources and information.

name: The Cult of the Backrooms
description: A cult that worships the Backrooms as a living entity. They believe the Backrooms is a test or punishment.

name: The Researchers
description: A group of scientists and scholars who study the Backrooms. They seek to understand its nature and find a way out.

name: The Merchants
description: A group of traders who exchange resources and information. They are generally trustworthy but will exploit desperate wanderers.

name: The Guardians
description: A group that protects wanderers from hostile entities. They are skilled fighters and know the Backrooms well.
